comment: Took him for "Core" in the fall of my freshman year. He's weird, kind of out there, but he's a good professor and he seems to care about his students.

Joes is a great person and very knowledgable about literature (especially Russian), but he sometimes ask too much of his students. I did have him for and SSIR, so the expectations are a bit different. He can also be biased to say people are wrong if they have a different opinion than his. A LOT of reading and didn't get any grade until the end.

Hands down one of the best professors I've had in my whole academic career. Extremely down to earth, genuine and will let you retake any test in which you got a C or lower. Participation, attendance and overall drill exercises are nearly one half of your final grade, so its key that you don't miss class. Not to mention he is super chill as well.
DId not receive one grade from him until final grades came out. Unfair is an understatement.

SO HARD! HARDEST FYS! DON'T TAKE. He would always give us A-/B+ or B+/B. We never really had a full understanding of what our actual grade in the class was. He's not fair, and he is a solid reason why FYS should not be taught at the University. Consider yourself WARNED!
crazy hard don't take. most likely the hardest fys out of all

One of my favorite teachers freshman year. He really sat down with me to help clarify odds and ends during the two semesters I took Russian. He is a really great person, who cares about the success of his students and is a practical joker at heart. I recommend him wholeheartedly to those interested in learning the Russian language. Remember study!
joe is awesome. nuff said. he's cool, down to earth and can really connect with his students. he's an awesome professor. I've had him for 3 classes. he rocks.
This guy is great. If you haven't thought of taking Russian before, you should, just so you can get him to teach you. Seriously,  he's awesome.
An excellent professor who really cares about his students. Challenging, but very fair.
Great teacher, interesting and provocative. Highly recommend.
Best Prof I've ever had.  He is not only an excellent teacher, but a sincere person as well.  Nothing more need be said.
Had Joe for both, and in both I was challenged and entertained.  Also went to St. Petersburg with him one summer - mindblowing experience!
If you have the chance, you should take Dr.Troncale. He challenges his students to go further, and look deeper. Difficult at times but well worth it. Made my experience at UR more fulfilling.
Awesome teacher.  Makes class interesting and fun.  Would highly recommend.  The best teacher I have run into thusfar at UR
Super energetic and makes class fun and exciting. Fair and gets pleasure out of teaching. One of the best!  Not a pull-over though.
